footnotes.text: هذا التمهيد هو مقدمة النسخة الإنجليزية

uncertain: The single title word is set in ornamental thuluth display calligraphy. Whether the small v-shaped and comma-like strokes floating above and below it are decorative filler or intended harakat cannot be settled from the image; they are read as filler, so the title is transcribed unvocalised as تمهيد.
